meta.title: Delete Conversation
meta.description: Adds "Delete conversation" and "Delete multiple…" to the session context menu, with Ctrl+Alt+D and Ctrl+Alt+Shift+D. DSH only offers archiving, not deletion; this plugin removes session directories from disk, so it asks for confirmation first. Deletion is irreversible. Batch deletion is capped at 5 per run and starts with nothing selected.
